title: 2.7 Numbers 6-10
unit_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
unit_outcome: Recognize common surroundings and identify, count, and describe concrete objects without using untaught location language.
lesson_title: Unit 2: Places, Objects, Numbers, and Colors
goal: Recognize, hear and say the number words six to ten, answer What number is it? for all ten numbers, and count bags, chairs, books, cars and pens.
grammar_function: Number words; What number is it? / It is number + number for all ten numeral cards; number + plural noun.
prerequisite: 2.6 number and one to five; 2.2-2.3 car, book, pen, bag, chair.
speaking_outcome: Say the numbers six to ten, answer What number is it? and count known objects.
